name: visual: JBox2D body falls, then rests
code:
java_import org.jbox2d.common.Vec2
java_import org.jbox2d.dynamics.World
java_import org.jbox2d.dynamics.BodyDef
java_import org.jbox2d.dynamics.BodyType
java_import org.jbox2d.collision.shapes.PolygonShape
def add_box(world, type, x, y, hw, hh)
  d = BodyDef.new
  d.type = type
  d.position.set(x, y)
  body = world.create_body(d)
  shape = PolygonShape.new
  shape.set_as_box(hw, hh)
  body.create_fixture(shape, 1.0)
  body
end
world = World.new(Vec2.new(0, -10))
add_box(world, BodyType::STATIC, 0, 0.5, 10, 0.5)
box = add_box(world, BodyType::DYNAMIC, 0, 10, 0.5, 0.5)
tag = Object.new
box.user_data = tag
60.times { world.step(1.0 / 60, 8, 3) }
p box.position.y < 10, (10 - box.position.y).round(1)
240.times { world.step(1.0 / 60, 8, 3) }
p box.position.y.round(1), box.awake?, box.user_data.equal?(tag), world.body_count

name: visual: ZXing QR round trip (UTF-8)
code:
java_import com.google.zxing.BarcodeFormat
java_import com.google.zxing.EncodeHintType
java_import com.google.zxing.BinaryBitmap
java_import com.google.zxing.RGBLuminanceSource
java_import com.google.zxing.common.HybridBinarizer
java_import com.google.zxing.qrcode.QRCodeWriter
java_import com.google.zxing.qrcode.QRCodeReader
text = "Grüezi from JRuby ✓ 日本"
m = QRCodeWriter.new.encode(text, BarcodeFormat::QR_CODE, 0, 0, { EncodeHintType::CHARACTER_SET => "UTF-8" })
n = m.width
px = (0...n * 2).flat_map { |y| (0...n * 2).map { |x| m.get(x / 2, y / 2) ? 0 : 0xFFFFFF } }
r = QRCodeReader.new.decode(BinaryBitmap.new(HybridBinarizer.new(RGBLuminanceSource.new(n * 2, n * 2, px.to_java(:int)))))
p r.text == text, r.text.encoding, r.barcode_format.to_s, r.result_points.length >= 3
